conventions: Rounding intervals: printed coefficient c and SE s are read as c +/- 0.0005 and s +/- 0.0005, so the admissible |t| range is [(|c|-0.0005)/(s+0.0005), (|c|+0.0005)/(s-0.0005)]; R2 and Delta R2 as printed +/- 0.0005. One-tailed critical t values used: df about 541 (Table 3): 1.283 (.10), 1.648 (.05), 2.334 (.01); df about 325 (Table 4): 1.284 (.10), 1.650 (.05), 2.338 (.01). F critical values: F(6,541) 2.11 (.05), 2.87 (.01); F(6,325) 2.13 (.05), 2.89 (.01); F(3,538) 2.62 (.05); F(3,322) 2.63 (.05). An entry is called inconsistent only if the whole admissible interval lies on the wrong side of the printed threshold. All computations are published-record arithmetic, not data analysis.
